title: The Memory Server Is Not the Memory
hook: Three coding harnesses needed one place to recall lessons. The first cloud sync caught the real design problem: shared memory needs review states and receipts, not a bigger transcript bucket.
for: Builders who use more than one coding agent or more than one machine and keep teaching each session the same lessons.
get: A live Claude, Codex, and Gemini context plane on Cloudflare, plus the catch-up failure that forced an explicit baseline and quarantined 16 old candidates.
do: Keep raw transcripts local, sync only redacted candidates, and make approval—not retrieval—the gate into future sessions.
previewAlt: Three agent harnesses feeding a guarded memory state machine, with raw transcripts held locally
